2-s51.condition: Раздел 6, упр. 2, с. 51. Послушай и прочитай скороговорку.
steps: An orange orange is in an orange cage.
2-s51.answer: An orange orange in an orange cage.

3-s52.condition: Раздел 6, упр. 3, с. 52. Послушай и повтори слова.
steps: parrot — попугай, page — страница, black — чёрный, white — белый, pink — розовый.

4-s52.condition: Раздел 6, упр. 4, с. 52. Найди попугая: какого он цвета? Кого увидела Элис за окном?
steps: It's a pink parrot in the book. Alice sees a green and red parrot at the window.
4-s52.answer: pink parrot in the book; green and red parrot at the window

5-s52.condition: Раздел 6, упр. 5, с. 52. Послушай и прочитай диалог.
steps: Open your books. Page ten. What is it? — It's a parrot. Good. It's a pink parrot. — Look! A green and red parrot! We are pirates!
5-s52.answer: Open your books. It's a pink parrot.

6-s53.condition: Раздел 6, упр. 6, с. 53. Выбери нужное предложение.
steps: They are pirates. Open your book. It's a green and red parrot. We are good pirates.
6-s53.answer: They are pirates. Open your book. We are good pirates.

7-s54.condition: Раздел 6, упр. 7, с. 54. Что говорят дети в костюмах?
steps: We are rabbits. We are pirates. We are dogs. We are parrots.
7-s54.answer: We are rabbits / pirates / dogs / parrots.

8-s54.condition: Раздел 6, упр. 8, с. 54. Подбери предложение к картинкам.
steps: They aren't parrots. They are pirates. They are dogs. They aren't rabbits.

9-s55.condition: Раздел 6, упр. 9, с. 55. Послушай и повтори новые слова.
steps: pink, orange, purple, brown, grey, black, white.
9-s55.answer: pink, orange, purple, brown, grey, black, white

10-s55.condition: Раздел 6, упр. 10, с. 55. Послушай и найди картинку с попугаями.
steps: Purple and yellow parrots — picture 3. Grey and green parrots — picture 1. Pink and orange parrots — picture 2.

11-s55.condition: Раздел 6, упр. 11, с. 55. Опиши попугаев по образцу.
steps: They are grey and green parrots. They are pink and orange parrots. They are purple and yellow parrots.

12-s56.condition: Раздел 6, упр. 12, с. 56. Послушай песенку и спой.
steps: Stand up! Sit down! Open your book! Read your book! Write in your book! Close your book!
12-s56.answer: Stand up! Sit down! Open / Close your book!

13-s56.condition: Раздел 6, упр. 13, с. 56. Попроси роботов выполнить команды.
steps: Will, open the door, please. Ted, close the door, please. Will, stand up, please. Ted, sit down, please.
